The data had a few quirks, and I picked the reading that reproduces your Q2 values:

- **Time zone:** `ordered_at` is stored in UTC. Your Q2 numbers only come out if dates are converted to Korean time (UTC+9) before deciding the quarter and month. Without the conversion, a, c, g and h all differ.
- **Segment names:** the stored values vary in case and spacing (e.g. `Enterprise `, ` consumer`). I trimmed spaces and lowercased them before grouping.
- **Duplicate customers:** some emails belong to more than one customer id. Your Q2 values for b and f (234 and 194) only match if customers are counted by email, so I counted them that way. Emails had no case or spacing variants.
